verses.en: And when they drew nigh unto Jerusalem, and were come to Bethphage, unto the mount of Olives, then sent Jesus two disciples,
verses.sm: Ierusalema, ua oo i Petefake i le mauga o Olive, ona aauina atu ai lea e Iesu ona soo e toalua, ua faapea atu ia te i laua,

verses.en: Saying unto them, Go into the village over against you, and straightway ye shall find an ass tied, and a colt with her: loose them, and bring them unto me.
verses.sm: “Lua te o atu i le aai ua lumanai oulua, ona iloa atu loa lea e oulud o le asini ua nonoa, o lana tama foi ua faatasi ma ia; lua te tatalaina, i le ta‘ita‘i mai ai ia te au.

verses.en: And if any man say ought unto you, ye shall say, The Lord hath need of them; and straightway he will send them.
verses.sm: Afai foi e fai ane se tasi se upu ia te oulua, ia oulua fai atu, E manao i ai le Alii; ona tuu loa mai ai lea e ia.”

verses.en: All this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying,
verses.sm: Ua oo nei mea uma, ina ia taunuu ai le upu a le perofeta, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: Tell ye the daughter of Sion, Behold, thy King cometh unto thee, meek, and sitting upon an ass, and a colt the foal of an ass.
verses.sm: Ia outou fai atu i le tama fafine a Siona, faauta, o loo afio mai ia te oe lou Tupu, ua agamalu o ia, o loo tietie i le asini, o le tamai asini foi.

verses.en: And the disciples went, and did as Jesus commanded them,
verses.sm: Ona o ai lea o ia soo, ua faia foi e i laua pei ona fetalai atu ai o Iesu ia te i laua.

verses.en: And brought the ass, and the colt, and put on them their clothes, and they set him thereon.
verses.sm: Ua la ta‘ita‘iina mai foi le asini ma le tamai asini, ua faaee i ai o latou ofu, ma faatietie ai o ia.

verses.en: And a very great multitude spread their garments in the way; others cut down branches from the trees, and strawed them in the way.
verses.sm: O le toatele o le motu o tagata ua fofola o latou ofu i le ala; o isi foi ua latou sala i lala o laau ma folasia ai le ala.

verses.en: And the multitudes that went before, and that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna to the Son of David: Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord; Hosanna in the highest.
verses.sm: O le motu o tagata ua muamua, ma e ua mulimuli, ua alalaga i latou, ua faapea mai, “Osana! i le alo o Tavita; ia manuia lé afio mai i le suafa o le Alii. Osana i mea e aupito i luga.”

verses.en: And when he was come into Jerusalem, all the city was moved, saying, Who is this?
verses.sm: to Ua oo ia i Ierusalema, ona vevesi ai lea o le aai uma, ua faapea ane, “O ai ea lenei?”

verses.en: And the multitude said, This is Jesus the prophet of Nazareth of Galilee.
verses.sm: Ona faapea atu ai lea o le motu o tagata, “O Iesu lenei le perofeta mai Nasareta i Kalilaia.”

verses.en: And Jesus went into the temple of God, and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves,
verses.sm: Ua ulufale atu Iesu i le malumalu o le Atua, ona ia tulia uma lea i fafo o e na fefaatauai i le malumalu, ma na fuli i lalo laulau a e na sui tupe, ma nofoa o e na faatau lupe.

verses.en: And said unto them, It is written, My house shall be called the house of prayer; but ye have made it a den of thieves.
verses.sm: Ua faapea atu o ia ia te i larou, “Ua tusia, E taʻua loʻu fale, o le fale tatalo; a ua faia e outou ma ana o e fao mea.”

verses.en: And the blind and the lame came to him in the temple; and he healed them.
verses.sm: Ona o mai ai lea ia te ia i le malumalu o e tauaso ma e pipili, ua na faarnalolo ia te i latou.

verses.en: And when the chief priests and scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children crying in the temple, and saying, Hosanna to the Son of David; they were sore displeased,
verses.sm: Ua iloa atu e le au ositaulaga sili ma le au tusiupu o vavega ua faia e ia, o tama foi ua alalaga i le malumalu, ua faapea ane, “Osana i le alo o Tavita”; ona matuā tiga ai lea o i latou,

verses.en: And said unto him, Hearest thou what these say? And Jesus saith unto them, Yea; have ye never read, Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings thou hast perfected praise?
verses.sm: ona faapea mai ai lea o i latou ia te ia, “Ua e lagona ea a latou upu?” Ona fetalai atu ai Ica o Iesu ia te i latou, “Ioc; tou te lei faitaulia lava ea, Ua e saunia le viiga mai gutu o tama meamea ma tama fesusui?”

verses.en: And he left them, and went out of the city into Bethany; and he lodged there.
verses.sm: Ona tuua lea o i latou e ia, a e maliu atu i tua o le aai ua oo i Petania, ua nofo ai.

verses.en: Now in the morning as he returned into the city, he hungered.
verses.sm: O le taeao ua foi atu ai o ia i le aai, ua fia taumafa.

verses.en: And when he saw a fig tree in the way, he came to it, and found nothing thereon, but leaves only, and said unto it, Let no fruit grow on thee henceforward for ever. And presently the fig tree withered away.
verses.sm: Ua silafia e ia le mati e tasi i le auala, ua oo atu i ai, a e leai se mea na maua ai, ua na o lau; ona faapea atu ai lea o ia i ai, “Aua neʻi toe tutupu ni ou fua e oo i le faavavau.” Ona mago loa lea o le mati.

verses.en: And when the disciples saw it, they marvelled, saying, How soon is the fig tree withered away!
verses.sm: Ua iloa atu e le au soo, ona latou taufaiofo ai lea, ua faapea ane, “Ua faapea ona vave mago o le mati nei!”

verses.en: Jesus answered and said unto them, Verily I say unto you, If ye have faith, and doubt not, ye shall not only do this which is done to the fig tree, but also if ye shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; it shall be done.
verses.sm: A ua tali atu Iesu ia te i latou, “E moni, ou te fai atu ia te outou, Afai ua ia te outou le faatuatua, ma outou le masalosalo, ona faia lea e outou e le na o le mea ua faia i le mati, a e afai tou te fai atu i lenei mauga, Ia siitia oe, ma lafoina i le sami, ona faia lava lea.

verses.en: And all things, whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive.
verses.sm: O mea uma foi tou te ole mai ai i le tatalo ua i ai le faatuatua, e maua lava e outou.”

verses.en: And when he was come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came unto him as he was teaching, and said, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority?
verses.sm: Ua ulufale atu ia i le malumalu, ua a'oa'o, ona o mai ai lea ia te ia o ositaulaga sili, ma toeaina o le nuu, ua faapea mai, “O le a ea le pule e te fai ai na mea? O ai foi na na tuuina atu ia te oe lenei pwe?”

verses.en: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I also will ask you one thing, which if ye tell me, I in like wise will tell you by what authority I do these things.
verses.sm: Ona tali atu lea o Iesu, ua faapea atu ia te i latou, “Ou te fesili atu foi aʻu ia te outou se upu e tasi; afai tou te taʻu mai lea ia te au, ona ou ta'uina atu lea le pule ou te fai ai nei mea.

verses.en: The baptism of John, whence was it? from heaven, or of men? And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say unto us, Why did ye not then believe him?
verses.sm: Se papatisoga ea a loane mai ifea? Mai le lagi ea, pe mai tagata?” Ona latou felafolafoai ai lea, ua faapea ane, “Afai tatou te fai atu, Mai le lagi; ona fai mai ai lea o ia ia te i tatou, Se a foi le mea tou te lei talitonu ai ia te ia?

verses.en: But if we shall say, Of men; we fear the people; for all hold John as a prophet.
verses.sm: Afai foi tatou te fai atu, Mai tagata; ua tatou fefefe i le motu o tagata; aua o la latou lea taofi uma ia Ioane, o le perofeta ia.”

verses.en: And they answered Jesus, and said, We cannot tell. And he said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.
verses.sm: Ona latou tali mai ai lea ia Iesu, “Matou te le iloa.” Ona fetalai atu ai lea o ia ia te i latou, “Ou te le taʻu atu foi ia te outou le pule ou te fai ai nei mea.

verses.en: But what think ye? A certain man had two sons; and he came to the first, and said, Son, go work to day in my vineyard.
verses.sm: Pe ni a fa outou? O le tasi tagata c toalua ona atalii; ua alu atu ia i le ulumatua, ua faapca atu, Sole, ina alu ia i le aso, seʻi e galue i laʻu tovine.

verses.en: He answered and said, I will not: but afterward he repented, and went.
verses.sm: Ona tali mai ai lea o ia, Ou te musu; ac mulimuli anc ua salamo ia, ua alu.

verses.en: And he came to the second, and said likewise. And he answered and said, I go, sir: and went not.
verses.sm: Ona alu atu ai lea o ia i le tasi, ua faapea foi lana upu ia te ia. Ona tali mai ai lea o ia, Le alii e, ou te alu; a ua le alu lava ia.

verses.en: Whether of them twain did the will of his father? They say unto him, The first. Jesus saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That the publicans and the harlots go into the kingdom of God before you.
verses.sm: O ai ea so laua na faia le loto o lo la tama?” Ona latou faapea mai ai lea ia te ia, “O le ulumatua.” Ona faapea atu lea o Iesu ia te i latou, “E moni, ou te fai atu ia te outou, E muamua atu tagata ao lafoga ma fafine talitane ia te outou i le malo o le Atua.

verses.en: For John came unto you in the way of righteousness, and ye believed him not: but the publicans and the harlots believed him: and ye, when ye had seen it, repented not afterward, that ye might believe him.
verses.sm: Aua na sau Ioane ia te outou i le ala o le amiotonu, a e tou te lei talitonu ia te ia; a ua talitonu ia te ia tagata ao lafoga ma fafine talitane; ua outou iloa foi, a e lei mulimuli ona salamo outou, ina ia talitonu ai ia te ia.

verses.en: Hear another parable: There was a certain householder, which planted a vineyard, and hedged it round about, and digged a winepress in it, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country:
verses.sm: “Ia outou faalogo mai i le tasi faataoto. O le tasi matai na fai le tovine, ua ia lotoàina i le ai, ua eli ai le soligávine, ua faia foi le ‘olo, ua tuuina atu e ia i e galulue i vine, ona alu malaga ai lea o ia i le nuu ese.

verses.en: And when the time of the fruit drew near, he sent his servants to the husbandmen, that they might receive the fruits of it.
verses.sm: Ua latalata ona po e matua ai le fuata, ona aauina atu ai lea e ia o ana auauna i e galulue i vine, ia maua ona fua.

verses.en: And the husbandmen took his servants, and beat one, and killed another, and stoned another.
verses.sm: Ona pupue ai lea o e galulue i vine i ana auauna, ua latou sasa i le tasi, ma fasioti le isi, ma fetogi le tasi i maa.

verses.en: Again, he sent other servants more than the first: and they did unto them likewise.
verses.sm: Ona toe aauina atu ai lea e ia o isi auauna e sili ona toatele i e na muamua; a ua faapea lava a latou amio ia te i latou.

verses.en: But last of all he sent unto them his son, saying, They will reverence my son.
verses.sm: A e mulimuli ane ua auina atu ai e ia o lona atalii ia te i latou, ua faapea ane, Latou te ava mai i loʻu atalii.

verses.en: But when the husbandmen saw the son, they said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and let us seize on his inheritance.
verses.sm: A o ia tagata galulue i vime, ua iloa atu lona atalii, ona latou fetautalatalai ai lea, O le suli lenei; o mai ia, tatou te fasiotia o ia, a e fai mo i tatou lona fanua.

verses.en: And they caught him, and cast him out of the vineyard, and slew him.
verses.sm: Ona latou pue ai lea ia te ia, ua lafo ia te ia i tua o le tovine, ona latou fasiotia ai lea.

verses.en: When the lord therefore of the vineyard cometh, what will he do unto those husbandmen?
verses.sm: O lenei, pe a sau le alii e ona le tovine, se a se mea na te faia i na tagata galulue i vine?

verses.en: They say unto him, He will miserably destroy those wicked men, and will let out his vineyard unto other husbandmen, which shall render him the fruits in their seasons.
verses.sm: Ona latou fai mai ai lea ia te ia, E matua faaumatia e ia na tagata amio leaga; ona tuuina atu ai lea e ia o le tovine i nisi tagata galulue i vine, latou te avatu ia te ia ona fua i ona tausaga.”

verses.en: Jesus saith unto them, Did ye never read in the scriptures, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner: this is the Lord's doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu Iesu ia te i latou, “Tou te lei faitaulia lava ea i Tusi, O le maa na lafoaiina e tufuga fai fale, ua fai lea ma maa tulimanu aupitoaluga; o le mea lea na faia e le Alii, tatou te oўo ai pe a vaavaai atu i ai?

verses.en: Therefore say I unto you, The kingdom of God shall be taken from you, and given to a nation bringing forth the fruits thereof.
verses.sm: O le mea lea ou te fai atu ai ia te outou, E aveesea le malo o le Atua ia te outou,

verses.en: And whosoever shall fall on this stone shall be broken: but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.
verses.sm: a e tuuina atu i se nuu e au mai ai ona fua.”!

verses.en: And when the chief priests and Pharisees had heard his parables, they perceived that he spake of them.
verses.sm: Ua faalogo ositaulaga sili ma faresaio i ana faataoto, ona latou iloa ai lea, o i latou lava ia na ia fetalai mai ai.

verses.en: But when they sought to lay hands on him, they feared the multitude, because they took him for a prophet.
verses.sm: Ona latou fia pue ai lea ia te ia, a ua latou fefefe i le motu o tazata; aua o la latou taofi, o le perofeta o ia.
